test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

N M L _ J N _ L J J _ M L J _ N M _ J J
solution:
Given : N M L _ J N _ L J J _ M L J _ N M _ J J 

By checking options :

 
• J M N J L → N M L __**J**__ J N __**M**__ L J J __**N**__ M L J __**J**__ N M __**L**__ J J → (It follows the pattern of : NMLJJ - NMLJJ - NMLJJ - NMLJJ)
 
• J N L M J → N M L __J__ J N **__N__**&nbs
